title: Triage
tagline: A third-person shooter on one dark hospital floor: free the people locked in the rooms before the infected break in.
readinessNote: One floor plays start to finish (rescue, bites and an infection clock, the stairs, a score and skills). The floor plan is already a text map in src/map.mjs, but only one floor exists and "Next floor" replays it with more infected; the first job is a list of floors chosen by ?floor=. Contains guns and zombie violence.
buildYourOwn: Floor plans drawn as text (walls, doors, locked rooms, cover, pickups, infected), weapons and their numbers, pickups, skills, sounds.
controls: Keyboard and mouse (WASD, mouse to aim and fire)
